description: Na₂FeCPO₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.85 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.71 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₆ octahedra, corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra,  a faceface with one FeO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 67°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.67 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one FeO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra,  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra,  a faceface with one FeO₆ octahedra, and  a faceface with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 63°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.69 Å. There are two inequivalent Fe sites. In the first Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with two NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.27 Å. In the second Fe site, Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and faces with two NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.21 Å. There are two inequivalent C sites. In the first C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.27 Å) and two longer (1.31 Å) C-O bond lengths. In the second C site, C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.27-1.32 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-43°. There is one shorter (1.55 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four FeO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₇ pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-48°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.56 Å. There are fourteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one C atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Fe and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom.
